title: Access Control
subtitle: Configure hotlink protection and domain-level IP allow or block rules. Saving re-renders the nginx vhost.

off.label: Off
off.description: No IP allow or block rules are rendered into the nginx vhost.

block.label: Block listed IPs
block.description: Visitors from listed IP addresses or CIDR ranges receive 403 responses.

allow.label: Allow listed IPs only
allow.description: Only listed IP addresses or CIDR ranges are allowed when at least one rule exists.

hotlink.title: Hotlink Protection
hotlink.description: Blocks external sites from embedding image files served by this domain.
hotlink.hint: The current domain and its www host are always allowed. Add one domain per line or comma-separated.

errors.modeFailed: Could not save IP access mode

geo.title: Country Rules
geo.description: Decides which countries may reach this site. The check runs at the web server, so it covers HTTP and HTTPS only.
geo.notConfigured: Country rules need a country database. Your hosting provider has not set one up yet.
geo.notDownloaded: A country database is configured but has not been downloaded yet. Country rules cannot be saved until it is.

off.label: Off
off.description: No country rule is written into the site configuration.

allow.label: Allow selected only
allow.description: Only visitors from the selected countries reach the site. Everyone else receives 403.

deny.label: Block selected
deny.description: Visitors from the selected countries receive 403. Everyone else reaches the site.

geo.limitReached: The limit of {{max}} countries has been reached. Remove one to add another.
geo.noteAcme: Certificate validation requests always pass, so an allow list cannot stop your certificate from renewing.
geo.noteIpRules: The country check runs before the IP rules, so an allowed IP address cannot reach the site from a blocked country.
geo.noteCdn: Behind a CDN the country is read from the CDN's address, not the visitor's.
geo.noteNoIpv6: The country database carries no IPv6 ranges, so IPv6 visitors are not matched.

rate.title: Request Rate Limit
rate.description: Caps how many dynamic requests one address may make per second. Images, stylesheets, scripts and other static files are never counted.
rate.noteStatic: Only dynamic requests are counted. Static files are served without a limit.
rate.noteBurst: A short burst of up to {{burst}} requests is allowed before the limit applies.
rate.noteStatus: A request over the limit receives 429 Too Many Requests.
rate.saved: The request rate limit was saved.
rate.failed: Could not save the request rate limit

reasons.geoip_unavailable: No country database has been downloaded, so a country rule would block nobody. Ask your hosting provider to download one.
reasons.country_unknown: The country database does not carry that country.
reasons.rate_not_allowed: That request rate is not available. Pick one of the offered values.
